name: gtm-enrichment-deep
description: Fixed three-call, read-only GTM enrichment bundle for one known business lead. Cross-checks Apollo professional identity, Hunter firmographics, and Apollo organization funding/revenue using a coherent work email and matching company domain; personal-email and phone revelation are disabled.

email.description: Known work email for the target business lead. Must belong to the supplied domain; do not use a personal/free-mail address.

domain.description: Bare employer domain matching the work email, e.g. acme.com.

steps.label: professional identity — Apollo people enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
company firmographics — Hunter company enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
funding and revenue cross-check — Apollo organization enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
